class.name: NNBTTimeLimiter
class.brief_description: Interrupts and fails its child if it runs longer than [member time_limit] seconds.
class.description: Enforces a deadline on a child branch using accumulated tick [code]delta[/code] (so it pauses safely with the tree). If the child finishes within [member time_limit] seconds, its result passes through unchanged; if the deadline is exceeded, the child is interrupted and this node returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE]. Use this to give actions like chasing a target or searching an area a maximum duration before giving up.

method.name: get_time_spent
method.description: Returns the elapsed seconds accumulated in the current run.

members.member: Maximum duration in seconds before interrupting and failing the child. Set to [code]0.0[/code] or less for no limit.
